dcat:Dataset.dct:title: Border crossing waiting time
dcat:Dataset.dct:description: As of 15 October 2025, the crossing time of the EU external land border when exiting the Republic of Latvia is determined individually only through the Electronic Queue Reservation System (ERRS). dcat:Dataset.dct:description: Winter season (Oct.16–Apr.15): Snow lasts for more than 4h within a 24hour period and the snow layer exceeds 12cm in thickness, freezing rain or rain occurs multiple times creating ice on the road, wind exceeds 20m/s, snow drifts on roads, rain causes road flooding or reduces the road's load-bearing capacity.
